input.quote: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The audit right has no frequency limit and no notice period (a request can be made at any time, as often as Licensor likes), although the independent-auditor requirement and the 5% cost-shift threshold already match our position. Redline adds once-per-12-months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, confidentiality-bound auditor and no system access.

input.quote: NO DAMAGES FOR TERMINATION. NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR DAMAGES OF ANY KIND, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, late-payment interest or minimum termination payment is imposed on us; Article XXIII expressly bars termination damages, and the only cost-shift is the audit cost on a >5% discrepancy, which is within our position. Note there are also no service credits in our favour — worth raising commercially alongside the warranty ask, but no redline needed for this rule.

input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX is a pure "AS IS" disclaimer that even disclaims that errors or non-conformity to Documentation "CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED", and there is no express performance or conformance warranty anywhere — our stated walk-away for a hosted trading platform. Redline inserts a workmanlike-services warranty, conformance to Documentation, no-malicious-code, and a re-perform/repair/refund remedy carved out of the disclaimer.
